newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: No Australian election before next budget - Costello.
newsitem.headline: No Australian election before next budget - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday it was unlikely that an election would be held before the next budget, unless the upper house of parliament, the senate, blocked key reforms.

"Unless the senate blocks important legislation and there is a double dissolution, there's no way you could have an election before the next budget," Costello told Perth radio 6PR, when asked if an election would be held before the 1998/99 budget was announced.
"We would prefer to spend all of this year and all of next year working on the reform programme."
